# 🧰 Project Templates

| Template | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [ADR](adr.md) | Record a technical decision |
| [Feature proposal](feature-proposal.md) | Scope new capability |
| [Bug report](bug-report.md) | Capture reproducible defects |
| [Test plan](test-plan.md) | Plan engine/UI verification |
| [Game rule change](game-rule-change.md) | Review rule semantics |
| [Architecture review](architecture-review.md) | Review system boundaries |
| [Design review](design-review.md) | Review interface and usability |
| [Accessibility review](accessibility-review.md) | Review inclusive interaction |
| [Security review](security-review.md) | Assess threat surfaces |
| [Dependency update](dependency-update.md) | Review package updates |
| [Risk register](risk-register.md) | Track project risks |
| [Gameplay playtest](gameplay-playtest.md) | Record player testing |
| [Content review](content-review.md) | Validate help and documentation |
| [Release notes](release-notes.md) | Summarize verified changes |
| [Incident report](incident-report.md) | Record incidents and action |
| [Pull request](pull-request.md) | Standardize implementation review |

Copy the relevant template, replace all placeholders with repository-specific evidence, attach board fixtures for gameplay defects, and update the handbook when behavior or architecture changes.
